info.name: Figma Render Images of File Nodes

params.name: file_key
params.description: File to export images from. This can be a file key or branch key. Use `GET /v1/files/:key` with the `branch_data` query param to get the branch key.

params.name: ids
params.description: A comma separated list of node IDs to render.

params.name: version
params.description: A specific version ID to get. Omitting this will get the current version of the file.

params.name: scale
params.description: A number between 0.01 and 4, the image scaling factor.

params.name: format
params.description: A string enum for the image output format.

params.name: svg_outline_text
params.description: Whether text elements are rendered as outlines (vector paths) or as `<text>` elements in SVGs.

params.name: svg_include_id
params.description: Whether to include id attributes for all SVG elements. Adds the layer name to the `id` attribute of an svg element.

params.name: svg_include_node_id
params.description: Whether to include node id attributes for all SVG elements. Adds the node id to a `data-node-id` attribute of an svg element.

params.name: svg_simplify_stroke
params.description: Whether to simplify inside/outside strokes and use stroke attribute if possible instead of `<mask>`.

params.name: contents_only
params.description: Whether content that overlaps the node should be excluded from rendering. Passing false (i.e., rendering overlaps) may increase processing time, since more of the document must be included in rendering.

params.name: use_absolute_bounds
params.description: Use the full dimensions of the node regardless of whether or not it is cropped or the space around it is empty. Use this to export text nodes without cropping.

items.docs:
Renders images from a file.
If no error occurs, `"images"` will be populated with a map from node IDs to URLs of the rendered images, and `"status"` will be omitted. The image assets will expire after 30 days. Images up to 32 megapixels can be exported. Any images that are larger will be scaled down.
